title: DISPATCH
universal_lens: The system formalizes a high-dimensional state-space governed by strict hierarchical priors and multi-gate conjunctions. It unifies discrete roster constraints with continuous probabilistic inference, enforcing mathematical rigor through Wilson score bounds and nearest-PSD covariance repairs to guarantee structural stability under extreme tail dependence.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps the mandatory engine gates into a Bayesian conformal framework. Live ESPN/Sleeper feeds act as dynamic likelihood updates against depth-chart priors. The statistical rigor—utilizing Copula tail dependence and robust Kelly criteria—ensures predictive intervals maintain exact coverage probabilities across non-stationary sportsbook environments.
gse_mapping: GSE operationalizes the L1–L5 reasoning trace as a directed acyclic graph of situational states. By strictly enforcing the OL -> Coaching -> QB hierarchy, the engine prevents invalid state transitions. The five-track checklist acts as a hard constraint satisfaction problem before any edge decision is published.

reasoning_traces.think:
The Phase 0 survey establishes a rigorous topological ordering for sports intelligence generation. We begin with the Live Roster Gate, acting as a boundary condition operator $\mathcal{B}$ that projects the infinite hypothesis space onto a finite, verified set of active entities using live ESPN/Sleeper feeds. This ensures all subsequent probabilistic evaluations operate on valid physical states. Next, the Hierarchical Reasoning Trace enforces a strict causal DAG: Offensive Line ($OL$) -> Coaching Scheme ($C$) -> Quarterback Behavior ($QB$). Mathematically, this imposes a conditional independence structure where $P(QB | OL, C) = P(QB | C)$ if $C$ perfectly mediates $OL$, though practically it acts as a hard constraint filter—if $OL$ fails threshold checks, $QB$ nodes are pruned from the reasoning tree. The Statistical Rigor Kernel introduces continuous valuation over this discrete graph. Using Wilson score Lower Confidence Bounds (LCB), we establish conservative edge estimates. These are fused via Copula functions to model non-linear tail dependencies between distinct signals, avoiding Gaussian fallacies. Finally, Higham’s nearest Positive Semi-Definite (PSD) repair guarantees the resulting covariance matrix remains geometrically valid for Bayesian robust Kelly optimization. The Conjunction Gate acts as the final projector, only emitting an `independentEdge.decision == "PASS"` if all preceding operators yield consistent, non-singular outputs.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architecture inherits from mid-20th century operations research and modern Bayesian networks. The strict hierarchical enforcement mirrors Pearl’s do-calculus for causal inference, while the statistical rigor draws heavily from quantitative finance—specifically Markowitz portfolio theory extended by Kelly criterion betting strategies. The use of Wilson scores traces back to early 20th-century binomial proportion estimation, adapted here for sparse sports data. Retrocausal Genealogy: Rooted in DISPATCH (63cf6bf0de10fa95), this derivation preserves strict unit consistency, explicit validity boundaries, zero-leakage temporal separation, and bounded structural integration across GSI calibration heads, spectral orthogonalization clusters, and GSE Stage-2 situational reasoning families without fabricating parameters.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models opposing agents (sportsbooks, rival quant funds) as adaptive optimizers attempting to exploit latent arbitrage. By enforcing a 5-track checklist and demanding agreement $\ge 2$ sources, the engine anticipates adversarial market movements. It assumes opponents will quickly price in isolated signals; thus, solo-source edges are shrunk aggressively. The reasoning trace effectively simulates the cognitive hierarchy of a head coach, prioritizing foundational unit success over star-player heuristics.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced via the Conjunction Gate and statistical repair mechanisms. If the Live Roster Gate detects a late scratch, it triggers a retroactive veto on all downstream L1-L5 traces dependent on that entity. Furthermore, if the Copula tail dependence reveals extreme collinearity between two supposedly independent signals, the Higham PSD repair will flag a near-singular matrix. This acts as a leakage veto, preventing double-counting of the same underlying information across different reasoning tracks.
